comparisons.peer_summary: The company provides Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and GPS/GNSS solutions for mobile devices, including integrated combination chips and location platform services.
comparisons.comparison: Both MU and Broadcom (AVGO) disclose specific product advancements targeting the smartphone market in 2024. MU announced second-generation NAND UFS 4.0 devices and began sampling next-generation low power smartphone DRAM (LPDDR5X) built on its 1ß node, explicitly noting that this technology is designed for high-end and flagship smartphones to support AI at the intelligent edge. Similarly, AVGO disclosed that its connectivity solutions include discrete and integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth solutions, and GPS/GNSS receivers designed for use in mobile devices including smartphones, offering high-performance, low-power Wi-Fi chipsets. Both companies highlight low power efficiency and high performance as key features for flagship mobile device designs.

sentences.text: In 2024, we announced our second generation of NAND UFS 4.0 devices, which offer a more compact package size and increased power efficiency to provide design manufacturers more room and power needed for next generation smartphone designs.
We also began sampling our next generation of low power smartphone DRAM, built on our 1ß node.
This advanced memory technology is designed for high-end and flagship smartphones where its high bandwidth and power efficiency are crucial for delivering top-tier performance.

• Connectivity Solutions: Our connectivity solutions include discrete and integrated Wi-Fi and Bluetooth solutions, and global positioning system/global navigation satellite system ("GPS/GNSS") receivers, designed for use in mobile devices including smartphones, tablets and wearable products.
Bluetooth is a low power technology that enables direct connectivity between devices.

comparisons.peer_topic: Processor architecture and AI Engine capabilities
comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm utilizes System-on-Chip architecture with heterogeneous computing, including Oryon and Kryo CPUs and Adreno GPUs, to enable high-performance, low-power computing. The Qualcomm AI Engine features dedicated hardware and the Hexagon NPU for high-performance on-device AI inference, supported by the AI Stack and AI Hub to simplify developer integration.
comparisons.comparison: MU and Qualcomm (QCOM) both emphasize the integration of high-performance, low-power memory and processing capabilities to enable advanced AI features in mobile devices. MU announced sampling next-generation low power smartphone DRAM (LPDDR5X) where the LPDDR5X provides peak bandwidth critical for enabling AI at the intelligent edge. QCOM disclosed that its processors use System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture with heterogeneous computing to enable high-performance and low-power computing, and highlighted its Qualcomm AI Engine featuring a dedicated Hexagon NPU for sustained, high-performance AI inference with very low power consumption. Both disclosures focus on the specific technical attributes (low power, high performance/bandwidth) required to support on-device AI in smartphones.

sentences.text: We also began sampling our next generation of low power smartphone DRAM, built on our 1ß node.
The LPDDR5X provides peak bandwidth data transfer that is critical for enabling AI at the intelligent edge.
This advanced memory technology is designed for high-end and flagship smartphones where its high bandwidth and power efficiency are crucial for delivering top-tier performance.

We have developed System-on-Chip (SoC) architecture with heterogeneous computing features, which uses our central processing unit (CPU) and different types of specialized engines (graphics processing unit (GPU) and neural processing unit (NPU)) to enable high-performance and low-power computing and other optimization techniques.

The Qualcomm® AI Engine, featured in our Snapdragon platforms and many of our other products, includes dedicated hardware capable of running complex AI use cases at high-performance and low-power on device, while also enhancing privacy and security.

Our Qualcomm® Hexagon™ NPU is a key processor in our AI Engine and is designed for sustained, high-performance AI inference, enabling leading on-device AI capabilities with very low power consumption.
